metadata.title: Masala Chai Recipe | Thand Ki Best Chai #shorts
metadata.description:
Masala chai recipe jo thand mein sabse best lagti hai!

Ingredients:
- Paani 1 cup
- Doodh 1 cup
- Chaaypatti 2 tsp
- Adrak 1 inch
- Elaichi 2
- Cheeni 2 tsp

Method:
1. Paani ubaalo
2. Adrak aur elaichi kootkar daalo
3. Chaaypatti daalo
4. Doodh aur cheeni daalkar 3 minute ubaalo
5. Chhaan kar garam pariso

Roz ek nayi recipe ke liye Subscribe karein!
